from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[v for v in counts if v not in (0,bg)]
    # The colored reference object is the nonzero, non-background color.
    color=colors[0]
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords)
    c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
    mask={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0+1)+1):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0+1)+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in mask):
                for dr,dc in mask:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
